short_description:
Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick told CNBC there are no plans to discount GTA 6 for the holidays (stores can still set their own prices). GTA 6 is $79.99, or $99.99 for the Ultimate Edition, and it isn't in PlayStation's Black Friday sale. What is: the DualSense controller at $54 (normally $74); no PS5 console discount. Our take: if you want it, don't wait for a deal.

Sources: Beebom, IBTimes, GamingBolt, MP1st (Zelnick/CNBC); Digital Citizen, Push Square (PlayStation Black Friday); Game Rant, Nacionale (price).

Nuestra opinión: si lo quieres, no esperes una oferta.
